Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + procurement/legal intros

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) started so we can align on evaluation objectives, procurement milestones, and the terms & redline path. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP and a short evaluation plan to help frame the timeline.

High-level ask: can you confirm procurement / legal contacts at Luma who will own PO terms and contract review? If you can loop them in here we’ll add contracting milestones to the MAP.

Proposed near-term timeline (subject to your procurement cadence):
- Week 1 (this week): introduce procurement/legal, agree on PO vs. MSA approach
- Week 2–3: Luma completes evaluation tests; Redwood provides test harness + support
- Week 3–4: contract review + redlines; target signatures by end of week 4

Attachments: Luma_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP draft), evaluation_plan.md (plaintext)

Next steps: if you can introduce James Li (procurement) and CC any legal reviewer, Marissa will own the MAP updates and I’ll coordinate the evaluation support.

Thanks,

—Sean

Hi all —

Great to meet you, Aisha — and thanks for the intros. Quick notes from Redwood’s side on roles & redline flow:

- MAP ownership: I’ll be the primary MAP owner. I’ll update the timeline and add a contracting milestone after James confirms approach.
- Eval support: Sean will coordinate the test harness; Redwood will provide an eval checklist and a short runbook.
- Terms / redlines: looping in Karthik (legal ops) who will be the terms owner and the point on contract language. Our usual path is: redlines exchanged in a single consolidated file, legal review cycles limited to two rounds, and we aim to agree on commercial terms in the first round where possible.

I’ve attached a short guidance doc for redlines to set expectations. If Luma prefers PO + supplier addendum that’s fine — Karthik, please confirm any minimum timelines for legal review so James can plan procurements.

Attachments: redlines-guidance.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

Thanks — I’ll push an updated MAP v0.3 once we confirm the procurement route.

—Marissa

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff + procurement/legal intros

Hi James / Sanjay / Aisha —

Thanks for the intro. Quick summary from legal ops on the contracting track and milestones we suggest to keep to the target close in four weeks:

1) Decision on approach (PO + supplier addendum vs. MSA): Luma to confirm by EOD Mon (Dec 14). If PO route, please share the standard PO terms and any SOW template.
2) Exchange of redlines: Luma sends consolidated redlines by Dec 18; Redwood will respond with counter-redlines by Dec 21.
3) Final legal review: limited to one commercial/legal reconciliation round (Dec 22–24).
4) Signatures & procurement: target DocuSign by Dec 28; PO issuance by Dec 30.

Notes / constraints:
- We typically accept reasonable confidentiality and data processing terms; any request for unusual indemnity or significant data residency changes will require extra cycles.
- If you have a standard supplier addendum, please attach it to your redlines so we can fold it into review.

I’ll be the primary terms owner here. For transparency, I’ll also record the review rounds in the MAP and flag any items that need escalation to our VP Legal.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: redlines-guidance.pdf referenced
